rows.heading: Materials and products
rows.summary: Requirements for the properties, construction, and performance of materials and products.
rows.explanation: These requirements can address physical, mechanical, or chemical characteristics, as well as what a product must be capable of doing. They establish a common technical basis for evaluating whether a material or product is suitable for its intended use.
rows.exampleText: establishes construction and performance requirements for smoke alarms, along with tests used to evaluate them.

rows.heading: Test methods
rows.summary: Procedures for measuring properties or evaluating performance under defined conditions.
rows.explanation: The procedure used to conduct a test matters. When testing follows the same specified method, results can be evaluated consistently. Results obtained using different procedures may not be directly comparable.
rows.exampleTitle: Standard Methods of Fire Endurance Tests of Building Construction and Materials
rows.exampleText: establishes methods for evaluating fire endurance.

rows.heading: Design and installation
rows.summary: Requirements for how equipment and system components are selected, arranged, and installed.
rows.explanation: These standards can address entire systems, not just individual products. They establish requirements for how components are designed and installed so they function together as intended.
rows.exampleTitle: Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems
rows.exampleText: addresses sprinkler system design and installation.

rows.heading: Inspection, testing, and maintenance
rows.summary: Requirements for checking and maintaining equipment or systems during their service life.
rows.explanation: Meeting installation requirements is only the starting point. Equipment and systems must also continue to function as intended. In-service requirements address how their condition and performance are checked over time.
rows.exampleTitle: Standard for Inspection and Testing of Fire Alarm Systems
rows.exampleText: specifies requirements for inspecting and testing fire alarm systems already in service.
